scope: Isolated real PostgreSQL API integration; not cloud deployment or team acceptance
checks: EF migrations create the relational schema
OpenAPI exposes authenticated domain REST operations
Swagger UI is available
Workspace rejects anonymous access
Invalid credentials rejected with a localized message
Account roles are determined by PostgreSQL-backed identity
Client projection contains only assigned shipments
Client cannot manage fleet through REST
Public registration cannot create coordinators
A newly registered client starts without shipment access
Sensor is an independent persisted root without a vehicle
Sensor assignment references the independent vehicle
A vehicle cannot be assigned two sensors
Invalid thermal range leaves no partial shipment or reservation
Concurrent overlapping bookings accept exactly one reservation
Unassigned clients cannot read a known shipment identifier
Stale shipment versions are rejected
An in-transit shipment cannot be cancelled
Missing reading values or coordinates cannot become invented zero measurements
Readings before monitoring started are rejected without persistence
A persisted out-of-range reading raises an alert
A corrective action acknowledges without resolving the excursion
Normal temperature alone does not resolve abnormal humidity
A later reading normal in both ranges resolves thermal excursions
An older excursion cannot reopen alerts resolved by a newer measurement
Reading the workspace does not mark notifications read
Explicit notification read only updates the authenticated recipient
Delivery releases the persisted fleet reservation
An authorized client can create a persisted immutable report snapshot
A generated report is not recomputed from later shipment edits
Report snapshots respect shipment assignment
A separate organization has an isolated projection
Even a coordinator cannot read another organization shipment
Cross-organization resource assignment is rejected
Passwords and bearer session tokens are not stored in clear text
Data and sessions survive an API process restart
Logout persists bearer session revocation
